jobs.title: Director of Product - Platform
jobs.description:
About 1X

We’re building humanoid robots that work in any space humans exist with the mission to create an abundance of labor. Simple, but it’s not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, software, hardware, manufacturing and operations at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a general purpose robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it, we're shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time safely creating abundance for all.



About the Team:

The 1X Developer Platform opens up 1X robot software so developers can build their own apps, integrations, and fine-tuned world models for 1X robots and eventually others. Software built on the 1X Developer Platform will be shipped in a 1X app store that verifies safety, security, and privacy. This will be the first robot developer platform launched at scale that provides more than a low-level SDK. This project involves the entire software engineering org at 1X.



Your Charter: The mission of this role is to own the 1X developer platform experience end to end, so customers trust and adopt the platform as we roll out APIs and services incrementally. You are inheriting technical debt, in-development APIs, and more competing priorities than any one team can carry. Your charter is to understand our customers deeply (both commercial & consumer), prioritize needs against hard engineering constraints, ship them exceptionally well, and build the flywheel that creates an ecosystem on top of a single product. This sits on 1X’s critical path because our customers need to use software to customize & extend 1X robot capabilities and create new businesses of their own.



Key Outcomes:

 - Own platform product strategy and deliver a clear, prioritized roadmap that answers why a thing matters, not just what ships next

 - Drive measurable gains in customer confidence and platform adoption, so customers succeed on the platform rather than working around it

 - Work closely with our partnerships team to understand customers, both commercial and consumer, and anticipate customer needs in long-term roadmaps

 - Lead API improvement while customers actively depend on the product, designing platform APIs that stay reliable for the long term without versioning or breaking customer software

 - Simplify the platform experience by making complex technology feel obvious, reducing friction, and creating secure, intuitive paths through the product

 - Build and develop the product management team, mentoring product managers and raising the standard for product documentation and written communication

 - Drive focus across competing priorities, resolving tradeoffs inside the team rather than escalating them to the executive team



Key Competencies:

 - Translate complex technical systems into simple product experiences that delight our customers

 - Set product strategy grounded in the why, and hold a prioritized roadmap against constant pressure to do more

 - Lead and develop product managers, improving both the quality of their thinking and the clarity of their writing

 - Balance customer expectations against real technical constraints, and make that tradeoff legible to both sides

 - Write with precision. Documentation and product communication are how decisions travel across a large engineering organization

 - Operate with focus when everything is urgent, choosing the few things that matter and finishing them



Minimum Requirements:

 - 10+ years in product management, including time owning a platform product end to end

 - Proven track record of building developer or infrastructure platforms used by external customers, not internal-only tools

 - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop product managers, as a Group Product Manager, Director, or product lead running a pod

 - Experience improving APIs while customers actively depend on the product

 - Demonstrated ability to set and defend a prioritized roadmap grounded in customer outcomes



Preferred Skills:

 - Experience in engineering or design before moving into product management

 - Exposure to hardware and software products shipped together

 - Familiarity with products serving small and medium businesses

 - Experience founding or building a company from early stage



What does a successful 1X Team Member look like:

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.



Compensation Range:

$225,000 - $275,000



Benefits:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

 - 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)

 - Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options

 - Commuter benefits (transit and parking)

 - Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support

 - Onsite snacks and catered lunches



Equal Opportunity Employer

1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You’ll work with all of the teams that write software for the robot, from firmware to Companion to AI, and own the one schedule that turns plans into reality. You’ll coordinate closely with the hardware teams to make sure our roadmaps converge to robots that we ship.


YOUR CHARTER

The mission of this role is to own the fastest credible path from requirements to product launch. You’ll own and drive the 1X Developer Platform by building one plan from multiple teams, reconcile it with hardware timelines / dependencies, keep it honest, and pull it forward. This is on the 1X critical path for the most important projects for the company.


KEY OUTCOMES

 - Own the integrated product development and launch schedule, connecting team milestones, hardware timelines, and company goals into a single critical path the whole company can trust

 - Define credible milestones, owners, dependencies, and dates that align with the overall product schedule, bringing clarity to complex problems

 - Manage cross-team dependencies and blockers, making handoffs explicit, surfacing risks early, and driving or escalating resolution before they reach a critical milestone

 - Maintain strong cross-functional communication, keeping teams aligned on status, priorities, schedule changes, risks, and decisions so work proceeds from a shared understanding

 - Drive the fastest credible path to launch by parallelizing work, accelerating decisions, shortening feedback loops, and removing constraints on the critical path


KEY COMPETENCIES

 - Build integrated schedules from engineering reality, not optimism. You know the difference between a date and a plan

 - Earn the trust of software engineers, product managers, designers, and hardware partners so teams bring you risks early instead of hiding them

 - Make dependencies and handoffs explicit across teams that work in different tools, vocabularies, and cadences

 - Drive decisions to closure. You would rather escalate a day early than report a slip a week late

 - Communicate schedule truth in plain language to everyone from engineers to executives


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in software engineering or technical program management for complex software products spanning multiple teams and/or orgs.

 - Experience taking at least one large software multi-team initiative from 0 to 1

 - Demonstrated ability to build and manage an integrated schedule spanning multiple teams, including dependencies outside of your control

 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related engineering field, or equivalent hands-on experience


PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Experience in robotics, automotive, or high-volume consumer launches

 - Familiarity with hardware product development

 - Exposure to products where software readiness gates hardware builds

 - Experience with schedule and program management tools such as Linear, MS Project, or Jira

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

$190,000 - $230,000 + Equity
